messages:
alia: looping in the postmortem follow-up for the 'ghoststream' partial-response pattern we saw yesterday. notes + actions below.
jun: thanks. quick recap — clients see stream hang ~120s then a partial chunk, reconnects sometimes drop the last chunk. reproduces on q2-load. :thinking_face:
marc: confirmed on staging with low-rps replay, looks like server-side flush + client read race. added heap traces to INF-5342.
katy: can we get a telemetry spike for 'stream_fragmented' and 'last_chunk_missing'? want counts by model/version.
ops-elena: will add prefixed metric and tag by route. ETA end of day tomorrow. JIRA INF-5342 linked: https://rdw.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5342
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03-22-ghoststream. assigned -> jun, ops-elena.
alia: action list proposal: 1) instrument missing-chunk metric (ops-elena) 2) add server flush guard to avoid mid-assemble flush (marc) 3) improve client reconnect logic to resume last-ack (jun) 4) add e2e replay test that asserts deterministic chunk ordering (katy) 5) schedule canary roll with new kernel (alia). deadlines inline.
jun: I'll own client reconnect. plan: introduce ack-window token in the ws handshake, backoff jitter fixes, and make resume idempotent. target PR by Fri 2026-03-27.
marc: I'll prototype server flush guard: hold ephemeral assembly until commit condition (either end-of-stream token or 200ms idle). PR WIP, hoping for review by Thu.
katy: e2e harness: I'll write a harness that replays recorded traces and asserts no partial-trailing-chunk. putting test into nightly regression, first run Mon 2026-03-30.
ops-elena: metric + alert: emit count and 5m rate, alert if >10 in 5m for prod. rolling this out today; will post task link.
alia: timeline sanity check: if all lands by next Tue (2026-03-31) we can do a limited canary in eu-west-1 and observe over 48h.
marc: question — does kernel change affect KV cache semantics? might need compatibility flag for dedicated nodes. flag PR will be small.
jun: noted — I'll make reconnect compatible with both old/new kernels.
katy: can somebody add a short acceptance checklist to the PRs? e.g., reproduce locally with replay, new metrics emitted, canary pass.
alia: yes — I'll add the checklist template to the postmortem doc.
ops-elena: done — checklist added: "metric present, e2e pass, canary <1% failure, rollback plan" :white_check_mark:
marc: also adding telemetry trace id in the flush path so we can quickly map chunk -> attempt. tiny change.
jun: will update client SDK with resume test vectors. ops-elena — can you coordinate SDK canary with customers on Dedicated?
ops-elena: will ping a couple of early adopters and schedule a 1-hour window for the canary, target Thu evening.
alia: owners + commitments recap: ops-elena (metrics + canary sched) by 2026-03-24, marc (flush guard + trace id) PR by 2026-03-26, jun (client resume + SDK tests) PR by 2026-03-27, katy (e2e harness) by 2026-03-30, alia (postmortem checklist + canary plan) by 2026-03-25.
marc: added INF-5342 -> branch ghoststream/flush-guard. will link PR when ready.
jun: INF-5343 for client resume branch ghoststream/resume.
katy: INF-5344 for e2e harness.
alia: cadence: we'll sync Fri morning 09:30 in #incidents for blockers. if anyone needs to reassign, post here.
sre-bot: reminder scheduled: sync Fri 09:30 in #incidents.
ops-elena: quick note — if we see recurring patterns after fix, next step is to add streaming session-level circuit breaker + auto-rewind. we should include that in follow-up backlog.
alia: agreed — add follow-up ticket INF-5350 for 'session-circuit-rewind'.
marc: one more guard: add unit that simulates delayed flush to ensure we don't regress.
katy: tagging QA: @qa-team, will need a quick smoke run during canary window.
jun: thanks everyone. will update PRs and post links here. :thumbsup:
